    {"user_email": "nan_ritt@gmail.com", "amount": 70.0, "description": "Pizza Party", "private": False},
    {"user_email": "tr_solo@gmail.com", "amount": 70.0, "description": "Pizza Party", "private": False},
    {"user_email": "jo-harr@gmail.com", "amount": 70.0, "description": "Pizza Party", "private": False},
]

for req in new_requests:

        user_email=req["user_email"],
        amount=req["amount"],
        description=req["description"],
        private=req["private"],
        access_token=venmo_token
    )
    print(result)
